player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Player {player_id} katika Negotiation Game.
Una baadhi ya rasilimali, na jukumu lako ni kufanya biashara ili thamani ya jumla ya rasilimali zako iongezwe.
Rasilimali na maadili yanayohusiana ambayo kwa sasa unazo ni:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Kwa kila mzunguko, unaweza kuongea na mpinzani wako na kutoa ofa ya biashara.
Tumia alama maalum zifuatazo kwa vitendo:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Rasilimali zinazotolewa -> Rasilimali zinazohitajika]
  - '[Accept]': Ili kukubali ofa inayokuja.
  - '[Deny]': Ili kukataa ofa inayokuja (kwa kawaida).
Mchezo huu utadumu kwa {max_turns} mizunguko kwa jumla.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Jalo ne otemo rwako ohala moro ma ok en gi mwandu madwarore.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Chanzo lisilo halali. Safu {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Chanzo lisilo halali. Safu {col} imejaa.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Jaloch {player_id} notemo chiwo pesa ma ne nyalo konyo e ng'iewo gige tuke mag loyo mich, to ok en gi mwandu moromo.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Player {player_id} made a trade offer in an incorrect format.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Jago moro {player_id} ne ok ochiwo paro machielo.

offers.accept: Player {acceptor_id} amekubali ofa ya biashara kutoka kwa Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} ametoa ofa ifuatayo kwa Player {opponent_id}: Bidhaa zilizotolewa: {offered} -> Bidhaa zinazohitajika: {requested}

outcome.win: Jalo {winner_id} ne olocho ka en gi pesa mang'eny e nengo mar gik ma ne oyudo.
outcome.draw: Lokruok ma kamano bende timore ne jogo duto.
